verdict.rationale: Vue ships a dedicated 'Migration from Vue 2' guide plus a companion 'Get Security Updates for Vue 2' page, directly addressing the major-version migration story, and community feedback corroborates a well-executed v2→v3 transition ('redesigned both internal architecture and a public API while keeping the users happy'). Missing for 10: independent hands-on migration reports/tooling evidence (e.g., migration build/codemod usage) and confirmation of guides for other major version jumps.
